title: Subagent Isolation for Exploration
scope: Map how OpenWorker's explore tool spawns a child TurnEngine in PLAN mode (hard-blocked writes/shell) with a fresh context for safe research without polluting the parent session.

explore_tool.purpose: A read-only research subagent with its own context window. Broad questions ('where is retry logic handled?') burn the main session's context on dozens of file reads; explore spawns a child TurnEngine over the same workspace with read-only tools and a fresh context; only its final report returns to the caller.
explore_tool.mode: Child runs in PLAN mode — PermissionEngine hard-blocks writes/shell no matter what the child decides
explore_tool.approver: No approver — child never needs an approval round-trip
explore_tool.parallel: Low-risk metadata (children are read-only) makes several explores in one assistant turn eligible for the engine's parallel execution (engine.py:664 _parallel_safe)
explore_tool.recursion: No recursion: the child registry has no 'explore' tool — child engine cannot spawn grandchildren

child_engine.registry: Child ToolRegistry gets a restricted tool set: file_tools (read-only, no allow_write), git_tools, search_tools
child_engine.tool_replacement: Replaced = {search_files, read_file, read_file_lines} — child uses openworker's own grep + windowed read_file instead of aisuite's
child_engine.provider: Child shares the parent's provider/model — same LLM, fresh context

instructions.task: Answer the research task by searching/reading code (grep, read_file, list_files, git_log/status/diff). Cannot write files or run commands.
instructions.report: Final message is the report — goes back to the caller agent, not the user. Self-contained: answer directly, reference path:line, quote snippets, note surprises.
instructions.failure_handling: If something wasn't found, say what was searched so the caller doesn't repeat the same searches

contrast_with_ai_factory.current: ai-factory's 'task' tool spawns intern subagents via build_worker_spec — these are FULL agents with write tools, not read-only explorers
contrast_with_ai_factory.gap: No isolation mechanism for exploration — an intern exploring code can accidentally write/overwrite files. Context bloat from many file reads in the parent.
contrast_with_ai_factory.location: factory/infra/tools_skill.py:362 (build_worker_spec) / :281 (load_skill delegates to it) / :399 (intern Agent creation with guard_tools)
contrast_with_ai_factory.solution: Spawn a read-only exploration intern: a child Agent with deps_type=ReadOnlyCtx, a FunctionToolset restricted to read-only tools (search_files, read_file, batch_read, list_files, get_repo_structure, get_file_symbols — NO write_file/replace_text/rename_file/delete_file), output_type=ExplorerReport, bounded max_iterations=10, no recursion (child registry excludes the 'task' tool). The child context is discarded after the report returns, keeping parent context clean. Mirror OpenWorker's PLAN-mode child engine (subagent.py:42 build_explorer_engine) which hard-blocks writes via PermissionEngine.

proposal: ai-factory's subagent spawning (tools_skill.py / build_worker_spec) creates full write-capable intern agents with no isolation. When the LLM needs to explore/research (e.g. 'find all usages of X'), a full intern with write tools is risky and pollutes the parent's context with file reads. OpenWorker's explore pattern — a child TurnEngine in PLAN mode with read-only tools only, no recursion, bounded iterations — should be adopted for exploration tasks. This prevents exploration subagents from hallucinating file writes and keeps the parent context clean.

pydantic_ai_2_impl.pattern: Pydantic-AI Agent with read-only FunctionToolset + output_type=Report model + deps_type=ReadOnlyCtx — child agent can only read, never write, forced to emit a structured final report.
pydantic_ai_2_impl.code:
from pydantic_ai import Agent, RunContext
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class ReadOnlyCtx(BaseModel):
    workspace: str
    allowed_prefixes: list[str]  # path-scoped reads only

class ExplorerReport(BaseModel):
    answer: str = Field(description='Direct answer to the research task')
    file_refs: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)  # path:line references
    searched: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)  # what didn't match, to prevent repeats
    surprises: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)

# Read-only tools only — no write_file, no replace_text, no shell
explorer_agent = Agent(
    model='litellm/gpt-4o-mini',  # cheap model for exploration
    deps_type=ReadOnlyCtx,
    output_type=ExplorerReport,
    system_prompt='You are a read-only code explorer. Search and read files. Never write. Your final message is your report.',
    retries=2,
)

result = explorer_agent.run_sync('find retry logic', deps=ReadOnlyCtx(workspace='/repo', allowed_prefixes=['src/', 'tests/']))
# result.output is a typed ExplorerReport — the LLM MUST emit structured JSON
# If it hallucinates a file_ref outside workspace, a model_validator(mode='after')
# checks file existence and raises ModelRetry to reject the hallucination
pydantic_ai_2_impl.why_now: ai-factory's LLMs burn context on exploratory file reads in the parent session, which then overflows and corrupts output. OpenWorker's explore tool (subagent.py:42) proves that a child engine with read-only tools + PLAN mode + bounded iterations keeps the parent context clean and prevents exploration subagents from hallucinating writes. The typed ExplorerReport output_type ensures the report is structured, not free-text garbage.
pydantic_ai_2_impl.harness_gap: ai-factory's intern spawning at factory/infra/tools_skill.py:362 (build_worker_spec) creates full write-capable intern agents with no read-only exploration mode. load_skill() delegates to build_worker_spec at factory/infra/tools_skill.py:281; the intern Agent is forged at :399 with guard_tools(allowed_funcs, budget) where allowed_funcs includes MODIFY_TOOLS ACL-wrapped for write access at :380-383 (wrap_with_acl(func, INTERN_WRITE_ROOTS)). No PLAN-mode child engine, no read-only FunctionToolset, no ExplorerReport output_type — exploration subagents can accidentally write/overwrite files and burn parent context on file reads. No typed output contract: the LLM emits free-text reports that may hallucinate file refs. Adopt: ReadOnlyCtx deps_type restricting allowed paths, read-only FunctionToolset only (search_files, read_file, batch_read, list_files, get_repo_structure, get_file_symbols — NO write_file/replace_text/rename_file/delete_file), output_type=ExplorerReport for typed report emission, pre-flight file existence check in model_validator(mode='after') to reject hallucinated file refs.
